_note: Military unlockLevels: the HAN 86's are real (10/18/25/34/42/50/57/65 of 72, seen in-game 16 Oct 2026); every other weapon's are that curve scaled to its own max level, an estimate until its real numbers are seen. Special unlockLevels the same way (HAN 86: 25/46/72). Placeholder slots until MW4's real camos are known: every weapon has 8 Military camos (itemId 0-7: the same set on every weapon in this mode, unlocked by weapon level, no challenge) then 3 Special camos (itemId 8-10: unique per weapon, a weapon level then a challenge). Fill in names, unlockLevel, requirement and imageURL as they are announced; keep the itemIds. Then Completionist (the `completionist` block): Gold (opens when the weapon's camos are done), Platinum (opens once every weapon in the class has Gold), Harmonic Break (opens once the launch roster has Platinum; each step's `unlock` is weapon/category/mode), each with a challenge (per weapon category under byCategory), and a final camo earned once the weapon has its Harmonic Break and the mode has final.harmonicBreaksNeeded of them (33 in Multiplayer: an assumption from leaks, not confirmed; unset in a mode means the weapon's own Harmonic Break is enough). Mastery 1-3 is mode-wide: unlocked as weapons earn the final camo (mastery.tierN.weaponsNeeded; unset = a third, two thirds, all of the launch roster). Multiplayer's challenges are from leaks, not official.
